name: Shaniwar Wada
description: Historic Peshwa-era fort palace in the heart of Pune built in 1732, known for imposing teak ramparts and light shows.

name: Aga Khan Palace
description: Majestic Italian-arched palace surrounded by manicured lawns, intimately linked to Mahatma Gandhi's freedom movement.

name: Sinhagad Fort
description: Iconic hill fortress perched 1,300 meters high, famed for misty monsoon views and authentic Maharashtrian pithla-bhakri.

name: Vaishali Cafe
description: Legendary FC Road institution beloved by students and intellectuals for crispy SPDP, Mysore masala dosa, and filter coffee.

name: Vohuman Cafe
description: Classic Irani eatery near Pune Railway Station celebrated for double cheese omelettes, maska pav, and steaming chai.

name: Goodluck Cafe
description: Storied heritage corner on Deccan Gymkhana serving bun maska, mutton keema, and caramel custard since 1935.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Pune
description: Opulent luxury retreat overlooking the Poona Golf Course, offering world-class dining, spa rituals, and bespoke hospitality.

name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
description: Premier business landmark on Senapati Bapat Road with grand rooftop lounges, luxury ballrooms, and fine-dining experiences.

name: Pashan Lake
description: Serene man-made water reservoir constructed during British rule, a tranquil sanctuary for migratory birdwatchers and morning walks.

name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
description: Fascinating three-story treasury containing over 20,000 antiquities, musical instruments, war weapons, and the famed Mastani Mahal.

name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
description: 8th-century monolithic rock-cut cave shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva, carved straight out of single basalt rock on modern JM Road.

name: Swargate Junction
description: Dense transit nexus with heavy bus traffic, severe pedestrian congestion, and frequent road bottlenecks. Caution advised during rush hours.

name: Yerawada Junction
description: High-speed multi-lane intersection prone to traffic merges, blind spots, and construction diversions. Drive with heightened alertness.
